raw_excerpt: Eleventy (11ty) v3.1.6 stable, v4.0.0-alpha.7 canary. 'a simpler static site generator.' Build benchmark: Building 4000 Markdown Files — Eleventy 1.93s, Astro 22.90s, Gatsby 29.05s, Next.js 70.65s. Production-ready: NASA, CERN, TC39, W3C, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla, Font Awesome, Apache, freeCodeCamp. 18,730,735 downloads, 82,000+ dependent repos. Full control over output (no injected markup). Multiple template languages: HTML, Markdown, WebC, JS, Liquid, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Mustache, EJS, Haml, Pug, TypeScript, JSX, MDX, Sass, Custom. Zero client-side JavaScript by default. No telemetry. Incrementally adoptable.
